mn122:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
mn122:2.1: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya kapilavatthuṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
mn122:2.2: kapilavatthusmiṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena kāḷakhemakassa sakkassa vihāro tenupasaṅkami divāvihārāya.
mn122:2.3: tena kho pana samayena kāḷakhemakassa sakkassa vihāre sambahulāni senāsanāni paññattāni honti.
mn122:2.4: addasā kho bhagavā kāḷakhemakassa sakkassa vihāre sambahulāni senāsanāni paññattāni.
mn122:2.6: sambahulāni kho kāḷakhemakassa sakkassa vihāre senāsanāni paññattāni
mn122:2.7: sambahulā nu kho idha bhikkhū viharantīti.
mn122:2.8: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ānando sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ ghaṭāyasakkassa vihāre cīvarakammaṃ karoti.
mn122:2.9: atha kho bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena ghaṭāyasakkassa vihāro tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.

mn122:3.1: na kho ānanda bhikkhu sobhati saṅgaṇikārāmo saṅgaṇikarato saṅgaṇikārāmataṃ anuyutto gaṇārāmo gaṇarato gaṇasammudito
mn122:3.2: so vatānanda bhikkhu saṅgaṇikārāmo saṅgaṇikarato saṅgaṇikārāmataṃ anuyutto gaṇārāmo gaṇarato gaṇasammudito yantaṃ nekkhammasukhaṃ pavivekasukhaṃ upasamasukhaṃ sambodhisukhaṃ tassa sukhassa nikāmalābhī bhavissati akicchalābhī akasiralābhīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
mn122:3.3: yo ca kho so ānanda bhikkhu eko gaṇasmā vūpakaṭṭho viharati tassetaṃ bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ yantaṃ nekkhammasukhaṃ pavivekasukhaṃ upasamasukhaṃ sambodhisukhaṃ tassa sukhassa nikāmalābhī bhavissati akicchalābhī akasiralābhīti ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
mn122:4.1: so vatānanda bhikkhu saṅgaṇikārāmo saṅgaṇikarato saṅgaṇikārāmataṃ anuyutto gaṇārāmo gaṇarato gaṇasammudito sāmāyikaṃ vā kantaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharissati asāmāyikaṃ vā akuppanti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
mn122:4.2: yo ca kho so ānanda bhikkhu eko gaṇasmā vūpakaṭṭho viharati tassetaṃ bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ sāmāyikaṃ vā kantaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharissati asāmāyikaṃ vā akuppanti ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.

mn122:6.3: tattha ce ānanda tathāgataṃ iminā vihārena viharantaṃ bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamitāro bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo upāsakā upāsikāyo rājāno rājamahāmattā titthiyā titthiyasāvakā

mn122:7.2: ajjhattaṃ suññataṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti tenānanda bhikkhunā ajjhattameva cittaṃ saṇṭhapetabbaṃ sannisādetabbaṃ ekodikātabbaṃ samādahātabbaṃ.
mn122:7.3: kathañcānanda bhikkhu ajjhattameva cittaṃ saṇṭhapeti sannisādeti ekodikaroti samādahati.
mn122:8.1: idhānanda bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ …
mn122:8.5: evaṃ kho ānanda bhikkhu ajjhattameva cittaṃ saṇṭhapeti sannisādeti ekodikaroti samādahati.

mn122:11.4: tassa ce ānanda bhikkhuno iminā vihārena viharato ṭhānāya cittaṃ namati. so tiṭṭhati

mn122:12.1: tassa ce ānanda bhikkhuno iminā vihārena viharato bhāsāya cittaṃ namati. so
mn122:12.2: yāyaṃ kathā hīnā gammā pothujjanikā anariyā anatthasañhitā na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati seyyathīdaṃ rājakathā corakathā mahāmattakathā senākathā bhayakathā yuddhakathā annakathā pānakathā vatthakathā sayanakathā mālākathā gandhakathā ñātikathā yānakathā gāmakathā nigamakathā nagarakathā janapadakathā itthīkathā sūrakathā visikhākathā kumbhaṭṭhānakathā pubbapetakathā nānattakathā lokakkhāyikā samuddakkhāyikā itibhavābhavakathā iti vā evarūpaṃ kathaṃ na kathessāmīti.
mn122:12.4: yā ca ayaṃ ānanda kathā abhisallekhikā cetovicāraṇasappāyā ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati seyyathīdaṃ appicchakathā santuṭṭhikathā pavivekakathā asaṃsaggakathā viriyārambhakathā sīlakathā samādhikathā paññākathā vimuttikathā vimuttiñāṇadassanakathā iti evarūpaṃ kathaṃ kathessāmīti.
mn122:13.1: tassa ce ānanda bhikkhuno iminā vihārena viharato vitakkāya cittaṃ namati. so
mn122:13.2: yeme vitakkā hīnā gammā pothujjanikā anariyā anatthasañhitā na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattanti seyyathīdaṃ kāmavitakko byāpādavitakko vihiṃsāvitakko iti evarūpena vitakkena vitakkessāmīti.
mn122:13.4: ye ca kho ānanda vitakkā ariyā niyyānikā niyyanti takkarassa sammā dukkhakkhayāya seyyathīdaṃ nekkhammavitakko abyāpādavitakko avihiṃsāvitakko. iti evarūpe vitakke vitakkessāmīti.

mn122:18.1: ime kho te ānanda dhammā ekantakusalāyatikā ariyā lokuttarā anavakkantā pāpimatā.
mn122:19.2: kaṃ atthavasaṃ sampassamāno arahati sāvako satthāraṃ anubandhituṃ apipayujjamānoti.
mn122:19.3: bhagavaṃmūlakā no bhante dhammā bhagavaṃnettikā bhagavaṃpaṭisaraṇā sādhu vata bhante bhagavantaṃyeva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti.
mn122:20.1: na kho ānanda arahati sāvako satthāraṃ anubandhituṃ yadidaṃ sutta geyya veyyākaraṇassa sotuṃ
mn122:20.3: dīgharattassa hi vo ānanda dhammā sutā dhatā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā supaṭividdhā.
mn122:20.4: yā ca kho ayaṃ ānanda kathā abhisallekhikā cetovicāraṇasappāyā ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati seyyathīdaṃ appicchakathā santuṭṭhikathā pavivekakathā asaṃsaggakathā viriyārambhakathā sīlakathā samādhikathā paññākathā vimuttikathā vimuttiñāṇadassanakathā evarūpiyā kho ānanda kathāya sotuṃ arahati sāvako satthāraṃ anubandhituṃ apipayujjamānoti.
mn122:21.1: evaṃ sante ānanda ācariyūpaddavo hoti evaṃ sante antevāsūpaddavo hoti evaṃ sante brahmacārūpaddavo hoti.
mn122:22.2: idhānanda ekacco satthā vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajati araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ.
mn122:22.3: tassa tathāvūpakaṭṭhassa viharato anvāvaṭṭanti brāhmaṇagahapatikā negamā ceva jānapadā ca.
mn122:22.4: so anvāvaṭṭesu brāhmaṇagahapatikesu negamesu ceva jānapadesu ca mucchaṃ nikāmayati gedhaṃ āpajjati āvaṭṭati bāhullāya.
mn122:22.6: ācariyūpaddavena. avadhiṃsu naṃ pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṅkilesikā ponobbhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇīyā.
mn122:23.2: tasseva kho panānanda satthu sāvako tassa satthu vivekamanubrūhayamāno
mn122:23.3: vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajati araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ.
mn122:23.4: tassa tathāvūpakaṭṭhassa viharato anvāvaṭṭanti brāhmaṇagahapatikā negamā ceva jānapadā ca.
mn122:23.5: so anvāvaṭṭesu brāhmaṇagahapatikesu negamesu ceva jānapadesu ca mucchaṃ nikāmayati gedhaṃ āpajjati āvaṭṭati bāhullāya.

mn122:24.2: idhānanda tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā.
mn122:24.3: so vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajati araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ.
mn122:24.4: tassa tathāvūpakaṭṭhassa viharato anvāvaṭṭanti brāhmaṇagahapatikā negamā ceva jānapadā ca.
